title: ProtectReady: Martyn's Law procedures and training records for standard-tier venues
summary: The UK's Martyn's Law (Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025) is expected to apply from spring 2027 to venues and events for 200+ people. Standard-tier venues must notify the regulator and have public protection procedures that staff know. ProtectReady writes the procedures from a short interview, trains staff with short lessons and keeps the records.
hook: "We run a 350-capacity music venue with casual staff who change every month. How do I prove they all know what to do if something happens?"
story:
**Sam manages a 350-capacity music venue and bar in Leeds.** Under Martyn's Law, his venue falls into the **standard tier**. Before the law switches on, he must notify the regulator (the SIA) and have **public protection procedures**: how to evacuate, invacuate, lock down and tell people what is happening, and staff must know them.

His team is 25 people, mostly part-time students who change every term. A one-off training session will be out of date by the summer. He wants a simple plan for his building, a 10-minute phone lesson for each new starter, and a record that shows who has done it, in case the SIA asks.
whyNow: The Act received Royal Assent in April 2025 with at least a 24-month implementation period, so duties are expected to apply from spring 2027. The Home Office published statutory guidance on 15 April 2026 and the SIA consulted on its own guidance until June 2026, so venues are preparing now.

solution.title: Venue interview
solution.text: a 15-minute guided interview about exits, capacity, staff roles and layout.

solution.title: Procedures drafted
solution.text: AI drafts evacuation, invacuation, lockdown and communication procedures in plain language, following the statutory guidance.

solution.title: Staff micro-lessons
solution.text: each staff member gets a 10-minute phone lesson and quiz, sent automatically to new starters.

solution.title: Records and reminders
solution.text: who is trained, refresh dates, drills done and procedure reviews, all with timestamps.

solution.title: SIA-ready pack
solution.text: one-click PDF with notification details, procedures and training records.
